Samir (Eng): I can take debrief lead for 3:00. what's the expected debrief length?
Priya (People Ops): 15 min standard, extend to 25 if we have a tie. Keep notes in the shared doc.
Maya (Recruiter): @Samir noted. 10:00 still missing a scribe — any volunteers?
Samir (Eng): I can scribe 10:00 but need backup for 3:00 if I'm debrief lead.
Elena (Hiring): happy to back up 3:00.
Priya (People Ops): awesome — assigned: 10:00 scribe Samir, 11:30 scribe Elena, debrief lead Samir at 3:00 with Elena backup.
Maya (Recruiter): quick rubric question — for take-home follow-ups, do we score on "approach clarity" separate from "implementation" or combine?
Priya (People Ops): good call. We had been combining, but for take-homes split them to avoid conflation. So two fields: "approach" and "implementation".
Elena (Hiring): +1. also remind panelists to mark "confidence" (low/med/high) so we can weigh recency.
Samir (Eng): small edge case: candidate used a library we don't allow in take-home (internal rule). How do we treat partial credit?
Priya (People Ops): treat as implementation penalty but still score approach independently. Note in comments. We'll add a checkbox in the form: "restricted-libs-used".
Maya (Recruiter): adding that to the candidate instructions doc.
Priya (People Ops): scribe checklist (paste into thread):
```
- take attendance + timezone in doc
- copy paste candidate prompt (for context)
- note any infra issues (recording/zoom)
- capture final score fields: approach, implementation, communication, confidence
- short bulleted rationale (1-2 lines)
```
Elena (Hiring): perfect. can we also ask scribes to capture any culture-fit flags separately? one-liner.
Priya (People Ops): yes — add "culture-flag" as optional field.
InterviewBot: Reminder set — panel reminders will ping 30m before each slot.
Maya (Recruiter): last ask: consent to recording — can scribes confirm candidate consent at start and flag in doc?
Samir (Eng): will confirm at start and mark "consent: yes/no".

Elena (Hiring): thanks!
